play_short: Download and manage torrents on Android and supported Chromebooks.
play_full:
Download torrents on your phone, tablet or supported Chromebook with JSTorrent.

• Add magnet links and .torrent files
• Choose your download folder and select which files to download
• Pause and resume transfers
• Download in the background when enabled, with progress notifications
• Browse your torrent files, trackers and peers

On Chromebooks, use the Android app on its own or pair it with the JSTorrent Chrome extension to manage the same library in Chrome. The Android app downloads and stores your files. The extension requires the Android app; updates may arrive separately.

In version 1.0.34 and later, the app interface is available in 19 languages, including English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. Older app versions may have fewer interface languages. Other device languages use a supported language or English.

Requires Android 9 or later on a supported 64-bit ARM or x86 device. No account is required to download torrents. Existing downloads are imported where supported; if folder access needs repair, select the original folder in Storage settings. Keep your files and library when updating.

Setup and support: https://jstorrent.com
chrome_full:
Add and manage torrents from Chrome with JSTorrent.

Install JSTorrent Desktop on Windows, macOS or Linux, or the JSTorrent Android app on a supported Chromebook. Open the native app, connect the extension and approve pairing when asked. This extension requires the native app.

• Add magnet links and .torrent files
• View transfer progress and manage your torrent library
• Use the native app directly whenever you prefer

The native app handles torrent connections, downloads and file storage. On Chromebooks, the Android app and the separate ChromeOS Linux preview keep separate libraries, settings and download folders.

The browser library is available in 19 languages. The extension's setup and connection pages are translated too. Language availability in the native app depends on its installed version.

If an update is still rolling out, use your installed native app and try again later. Updating does not require clearing your library. Linux desktop support is best effort; check the website for system requirements and headless instructions.

Setup and support: https://jstorrent.com
